info.title: Wmo Utrecht API
info.description:
Callcenter and municipal accounts can look up Utrecht residents. Callcenter
accounts can also book rides. Taxi-company accounts can list rides assigned to
their company. The demo contains fictional records.

## Authentication

Send a personal access token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, or
use a web session with CSRF protection. The token management endpoints require
a web session. Token creation also requires the account password.

## Dates and distances

Distances are in whole meters. Budget periods and taxi assignments start at
midnight in `Europe/Amsterdam`. Their end dates are exclusive. If the annual
budget for the ride date has yet to open, booking returns HTTP 409.

## Errors

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 401 | Authentication required |
| 403 | Access denied |
| 404 | Resource not found |
| 409 | Business conflict |
| 422 | Validation failed |

Lists residents registered in Utrecht, including those without a Wmo authorization.
The `search` parameter matches names and resident references. Follow `links.next` for the next page.

post.description:
The Wmo authorization must be active at booking and on the ride date.
The resident's home address determines the parcel. The ride date determines
which taxi assignment and budget period apply. A successful booking debits that budget immediately.
Send `scheduled_at` as a future ISO 8601 timestamp with a UTC offset or `Z`.

The same account, key and booking details return the existing ride with HTTP 201.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for the booking within the authenticated account. Reuse it when retrying the same booking.

409.description: Inactive authorization, missing budget period, insufficient allowance, missing parcel or assignment, or a key reused for a different booking.

get.description:
Ride totals cover the taxi company's assignments or the callcenter account's bookings.
Municipal accounts get aggregate resident, authorization, budget and parcel figures.
Lists token metadata for the signed-in account. Requires a web session.

post.description:
Requires a web session and the account password. Abilities are assigned by role.
The token expires after 30 days. The plaintext value appears only in the creation response.

delete.description: Requires a web session. The token must belong to the signed-in account.
